section_summary: This section holds narcotics statistical forms and correspondence from 1947. It begins with Korea's annual statistical forms for 1946 and then has State Department, UN and Treasury Bureau of Narcotics routing papers. It also has Japanese and Korean narcotics regulations and the 1948 drug estimate forms for Japan and Korea. It ends with USAMGIK Public Health Order No. 3 on narcotics licensing.

subfiles.about: Korea's annual import and export statistics for codeine and ethylmorphine, reporting imports from US Army stocks.
subfiles.from: Government of Korea, Public Health and Welfare (Col. Keeney)
subfiles.summary: Korea reports codeine imports of 142055 from US Army stocks, with nil exports and nil ethylmorphine. Instructions and equivalence tables are included.
subfiles.title: Statistical Form A(L) annual statistics, methylmorphine and ethylmorphine, Korea 1946

subfiles.about: Blank annual form for consumption, government purchases and compounding quantities of narcotics, with notes.
subfiles.summary: Mostly blank form with instructions, drug columns, notes on morphine and cocaine and table of equivalences. Little data entered.
subfiles.title: Statistical Form C(1) blank: consumption and government purchases

subfiles.about: Korea's annual statistics on production and manufacture of narcotics for 1946.
subfiles.from: Government of Korea, Public Health and Welfare (Paul K. Keeney)
subfiles.summary: All entries for raw opium, coca leaves, morphine, heroin, cocaine and ecgonine are nil. Instructions and notes included.
subfiles.title: Statistical Form C(2) production and manufacture, Korea 1946

subfiles.about: Annual statistics of confiscated narcotics, with remarks on seizures in Korea.
subfiles.summary: Remarks report 67 kilograms of raw opium and some morphine confiscated in Korea's interior, to be destroyed after court cases. Notes and equivalence tables follow.
subfiles.title: Statistical Form on confiscations, Korea

subfiles.about: Forwards UN Secretary General's note of April 23, 1947 transmitting a drug addiction questionnaire.
subfiles.summary: State Department sends UN document E/CN.7/64 for appropriate action.
subfiles.title: Despatch 419 forwarding UN questionnaire on drug addiction
subfiles.to: US Political Adviser to SCAP, Tokyo

subfiles.about: Encloses UN Secretary-General's letter on an ECOSOC resolution on narcotics control in Japan.
subfiles.from: US Representative to the United Nations (Leroy D. Stinebower)
subfiles.summary: Transmits the letter of May 8, 1947 for forwarding to the Political Adviser to SCAP.
subfiles.title: Despatch 2430 forwarding UN letter on narcotics control in Japan

subfiles.about: Quotes the ECOSOC resolution asking Pacific Headquarters for narcotics reports.
subfiles.summary: ECOSOC approved approaching authorities at Pacific Headquarters for reports under the 1912, 1931 and 1936 conventions. It refers to two earlier notes of April 8, 1947.
subfiles.title: UN Secretary-General note on ECOSOC resolution on narcotics control in Japan

subfiles.about: Lists treaty obligations by convention and article.
subfiles.summary: Table of parties' obligations on laws, controls, manufacture limits, reports and penalties across the four narcotics conventions.
subfiles.title: Table of obligations under the 1912, 1925, 1931 and 1936 narcotics conventions

subfiles.about: Sends reports from Japan and Korea on first-quarter 1947 imports and exports for the Permanent Central Board.
subfiles.from: Will S. Wood, Deputy Commissioner of Narcotics
subfiles.summary: Three copies of each report are enclosed for transmission to the Permanent Central Board.
subfiles.title: Letter from Bureau of Narcotics transmitting Japan and Korea quarterly reports
subfiles.to: George A. Morlock, Department of State

subfiles.about: Quarterly import and export statistics form for narcotics with notes and equivalence tables.
subfiles.summary: Imports and exports are largely entered as nil. Instructions, notes and equivalence tables are included.
subfiles.title: Statistical Form A(GL) quarterly imports and exports, first quarter 1947

subfiles.about: Sends Japan's first-quarter 1947 Form A(GL).
subfiles.summary: Transmits Japan's quarterly narcotics import and export statistics.
subfiles.title: Transmittal of Form A(GL) to President of Permanent Central Opium Board
subfiles.to: President, Permanent Central Opium Board, Bern

subfiles.about: Translation of Japan's narcotics regulation, covering definitions, licensing, dealer duties, records and penalties.
subfiles.summary: Defines narcotics and dealer classes and sets licensing by the Minister of Welfare. It covers registers, sale rules, reports, record keeping, inspection and confiscation. Penalties include penal servitude and fines, and related Medical Law provisions are amended.
subfiles.title: Japanese Narcotics Regulation (English translation, E/NL.1947/5)

subfiles.about: Asks the US Representative to send a note to the UN Secretary-General on forwarding procedure for reports.
subfiles.summary: Refers to despatch 2227 and proposes a note citing Tokyo's despatch 1123 about reports for Japan and Korea.
subfiles.title: Instruction to US Representative to UN on forwarding narcotics reports
subfiles.to: US Representative to the United Nations, New York

subfiles.about: Reports that Japan and Korea narcotics reports go directly to the Commissioner of Narcotics.
subfiles.summary: The Public Health and Welfare Section will forward reports on time. The Adviser requests that the UN be informed of this method.
subfiles.title: Tokyo despatch 1123 on procedure for forwarding narcotics communications and reports

subfiles.about: Acknowledges instruction 492 and says the questionnaire went to the Public Health and Welfare Section.
subfiles.summary: The questionnaire is to be completed and sent to the UN before August 1.
subfiles.title: Tokyo despatch 1122 on narcotics control questionnaire

subfiles.about: Acknowledges instruction 499 on the UN drug addiction questionnaire.
subfiles.summary: The Public Health and Welfare Section will complete it before August 1, 1947.
subfiles.title: Tokyo despatch 1124 on drug addiction questionnaire

subfiles.about: Acknowledges receipt of documents including those on Korea.
subfiles.from: Secretary, Permanent Central Opium Board, Geneva
subfiles.summary: Brief acknowledgment of statistical documents received.
subfiles.title: Permanent Central Opium Board acknowledgment of receipt of documents

subfiles.about: Notes due dates for stock and confiscation statistics, with a charge slip.
subfiles.summary: Form D(GL) stocks are due May 31 and form E(GL) confiscations March 31. A charge slip for a Treasury enclosure follows.
subfiles.title: Memorandum note on statistical forms D(GL) and E(GL) due dates

subfiles.about: Sends Japan and Korea 1948 drug estimates and Korea's 1946 traffic report.
subfiles.summary: Transmits Statistical Forms B(L) and Korea's 1946 report.
subfiles.title: Transmittal of Form B(L) estimates and Korea 1946 report to Permanent Central Opium Board
subfiles.to: President, Permanent Central Opium Board, Bern

subfiles.about: Japan's 1948 estimates of drug requirements.
subfiles.from: SCAP Public Health and Welfare Section (Col. Crawford F. Sams)
subfiles.summary: Estimates include morphine 458 kg 832, cocaine 199 kg 900, codeine 1,537 kg 074 and dionine 34 kg 214.
subfiles.title: Statistical Form B(L) annual estimates for 1948, Japan

subfiles.about: Korea's 1948 drug estimates.
subfiles.from: Government of Korea, Public Health and Welfare
subfiles.summary: Estimates include morphine 66 kg 324, cocaine 18 kg and codeine 152 kg. They rest on a ten-year consumption average with a one-year reserve.
subfiles.title: Statistical Form B(L) annual estimates for 1948, Korea

subfiles.about: Department order regulating narcotics licensing in Korea.
subfiles.from: Department of Public Health and Welfare, US Army Military Government in Korea
subfiles.summary: Sets purpose and prohibits unlicensed narcotics activity, then defines licence classes and the application process. It sets fees, annual licence duration and renewal, lapse and surrender rules, and suspension provisions.
subfiles.title: USAMGIK Public Health Order No. 3, Narcotics Regulation
